identification_key: Lobby portraits carry no names; cookies named by element icon + art + class icon, cross-checked with the author's text and the 10-09 keys (r2026-10-09/08-extract/dc-2.json, dc-3.json). 브시커 = light, brown hair, purple eye, pink goggles, crossbow icon (crumb.gg card in 84309 names the same art 브라이트시커). 샤르도네 = grass, pale lilac/pink hair with green streaks, double-chevron icon. 전갈 = fire, red hair, crossbow. 메소 = water, green hair, white goggles, crossbow. 팝콘 = light, star-spangled red/blue glasses, popcorn bucket, crossbow, purple (epic) frame (84894; matches the title '전갈 팝콘'). 딸크 = light, pink fluffy hair, shield icon (84434, 84772; matches the titles/text naming 딸크 and no other non-standard cookie). 피노 = dark, grey hair, monocle. 치케 = light, gold curly hair, blue frame. 석류 = dark, red curly hair. 피겨 = water, yellow face, purple headphones, bell icon. 정전 = grass, teal hair, orange flower, bell icon, purple frame. 우유 = light, white nurse, purple leader banner, pink bear. 닼초 = dark, black/red hair, shield icon. 실론 = light, white-bearded knight, shield icon (84398 detail screen names it 실론나이트 쿠키, SSR, 빛속성, 방어). Stars: five slots per card; gold only = 1–5★ (grey/empty slots count as missing), each pink star replaces a gold one (1 pink + 4 gold = 6★, 5 pink = 10★); read from 2–4x lanczos crops of each star row, all reads clear unless marked '?'. Pets: bun with sauce = 핫도그, green cactus/octopus = 와사비문어, white round with red/green trim = 색동주머니; the number on each pet tile is transcribed as ★N. Lobby positions are given as rNcM (row, column) of the 12-card grid; that is list order, not proven formation.

posts.title_en: Scorpion's poison does take crit rate and crit damage; I wrote out why, so the client-decompiling guy should check
posts.summary_en: Datamine (ARM64 client code) claiming Scorpion's poison DoT rolls crit and applies the crit-damage multiplier: each poison tick creates a separate DamageData passed to the normal DamageSystem.CalculatedDamage, which does the crit roll and multiplier; the IsWeakEffect=true flag on poison was not found to exclude crit damage. Poison ticks use stored (snapshotted) caster stats; whether the snapshot is at cast or at poison application is unconfirmed. The earlier claimant (도미) replies he still cannot find it in the client he decompiled and asks for help.
mechanics: Scorpion's needle initial hit and the poison applied on hit are processed separately (author, datamine)

DamageOverTimeModifierSystem.EffectJob.Execute (0x35dea0) creates a DamageData per poison tick and passes it to DamageSystem.CalculatedDamage (0x2f1364), which runs the crit roll (0x2f2b3c–0x2f2c68) and applies the crit-damage multiplier (0x2f31ac–0x2f3270)
Poison data has IsWeakEffect=true, but no branch excluding the poison's crit-damage multiplier was found
Poison ticks read stored caster stats (crit rate, crit dmg, ATK), not live stats; snapshot timing (skill cast vs poison application) unconfirmed
disagreements: Author (초코초코케이크): crit rate and crit damage apply to poison. 도미 (ㅇㅇ 2), who earlier claimed crit dmg doesn't apply: cannot find it in the client he decompiled, asks the author to help, shares a Google Drive folder
ㅇㅇ 1 sides with the author from observed damage: it must apply, judging by the damage numbers

quotes.kr: 결론부터 말하면 전갈 독뎀에도 치확 치피 정상적으로 적용됨.
quotes.en: Bottom line first: crit rate and crit damage apply normally to Scorpion's poison damage too.

quotes.kr: DamageOverTimeModifierSystem.EffectJob.Execute에서 독 피해가 발생할 때마다 별도의 DamageData를 생성하고, 이 데이터가 일반 피해 계산 시스템인 DamageSystem.CalculatedDamage로 전달됨.
quotes.en: Every time poison damage occurs, DamageOverTimeModifierSystem.EffectJob.Execute creates a separate DamageData, which is passed to the normal damage calculation, DamageSystem.CalculatedDamage.

quotes.kr: 독 데이터에 IsWeakEffect=true라는 설정도 있는데, 이 설정 때문에 독의 치명타 피해 배율이 제외되는 분기도 확인되지 않았음.
quotes.en: The poison data also has IsWeakEffect=true, but I found no branch where that setting excludes the poison's crit-damage multiplier.

quotes.kr: 독 틱마다 현재 능력치를 새로 조회하는 게 아니라 저장된 시전자 능력치를 사용하는 구조인데, 그 능력치가 스킬 시전 시점에 저장되는지 독을 부여하는 시점에 저장되는지는 추가 확인이 필요하긴함
quotes.en: Each poison tick uses the caster's stored stats rather than looking up current stats, but whether they are stored at skill cast or at poison application still needs checking.

posts.title_en: Is it true that volley synergies stack?
posts.summary_en: Asks if two volley-2 givers make a 4-shot skill fire 8. Answers: no. One commenter gives per-skill formulas: Melon Soda 25 shots + 5 per synergy level (Melon+Pinot 35, + a multi-hit pet 45); Scorpion 4 + 2 per synergy level (8 with Chardonnay, 10 with Tiger Lily); only a pet's and a cookie's synergy stack.
mechanics: Volley synergy applies differently per skill (ㅇㅇ 1, stated, not shown measured)
Melon Soda: base 25 shots + synergy × 5; Melon Soda + Pinot = 35; + a 연타 (multi-hit) pet = 45
Scorpion: base 4 shots + synergy × 2; with Chardonnay (다발2) 8, with Tiger Lily (다발3) 10
Only pet + cookie volley synergies stack; cookie + cookie do not
disagreements: OP heard that cookie volley synergies stack (and lists Jungle Warrior as 다발2); commenters say no and that Tiger Lily's is 다발3 (10 Scorpion shots)

quotes.kr: 시너지는 캐릭스킬마다 다르게 적용됨가령 메소는 기본 25발에 시너지수*5가 더해져서메소+피노 35발메소+피노+연타펫 45발전갈은 기본 4발에 시너지수 *2샤르8발정전10발임시너지가 중첩되는건 펫과 쿠키만
quotes.en: Synergy applies differently per cookie skill. E.g. Melon Soda's base 25 shots get synergy × 5 added: Melon Soda + Pinot = 35 shots, Melon Soda + Pinot + multi-hit pet = 45. Scorpion's base 4 shots get synergy × 2: 8 with Chardonnay, 10 with Tiger Lily. Only a pet and a cookie stack synergy.
